description: We're looking for like-minded individuals who share our vision of changing how people perceive and understand rockets. People who are passionate about innovation, curious about the science behind rocketry, and willing to challenge conventional perspectives to help shape the future of space exploration.
summary:
Orbital Lab is a 3D learning platform that helps people understand rockets in a more fun and engaging way. Users can explore rocket parts learn what they do investigate possible rocket failures and see what happens through 3D simulations. It also includes mission games where players must manage their budget spend money wisely save resources and make decisions to complete their missions successfully.

Our project makes learning about rockets easier and more interesting by allowing people to explore and experience things for themselves of just reading about them. We hope to inspire people to become interested, in rockets, science and space exploration
details: During development, our team focused on creating features that make learning about rockets more interactive. Orbital Lab includes a 3D Rocket Exploration feature where users can click on different rocket components to learn about their functions, a Failure Investigation Mode where users can investigate rocket malfunctions and see what happens if they continue, and a Mission Game where players must overcome obstacles, plan missions, manage their budget, save money, and allocate resources wisely. These features were developed through coding using HTML. We also considered user experience, accessibility, educational value, and how to make complex rocket concepts easier to understand. Our aim was to create something that encourages curiosity, critical thinking, and smarter decision-making.
